title: Binance Adds LayerZero (ZRO) on Earn, Buy Crypto, Convert, Margin & Futures
text: This is a general announcement. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region.  Fellow Binancians, Binance is excited to announce that  LayerZero (ZRO)  has been added to  Binance Simple Earn ,  "Buy Crypto" , and  Binance Convert . In addition, Binance will add  ZRO  on  Binance Margin ,  Binance Futures  and  Binance Auto-Invest  at  2024-06-20 14:00 (UTC), 2024-06-20 14:30 (UTC)  and  2024-06-24 10:00 (UTC)  respectively.  Earn Users can now subscribe to  ZRO Flexible Products  on Binance Simple Earn. From  2024-06-24 at 10:00 (UTC) , users may purchase ZRO using any of the payment options supported on  Binance Auto-Invest . Buy & Sell Crypto Users may now buy ZRO directly with their  credit/debit cards, Google Pay, Apple Pay , or buy and sell ZRO directly with their available  wallet balances  at the “ Buy Crypto ” page. Convert Users can now trade ZRO against BTC, USDT, and any other tokens supported by  Binance Convert  at  zero fees .  Margin Binance Margin will add  ZRO  as a new borrowable asset on Cross and Isolated Margin, as well as the  ZRO/USDT  pair on Cross and Isolated Margin at  2024-06-20 14:00 (UTC) . Please refer to  Margin Data  for a list of the most updated marginable assets and further information on specific limits, collateral ratio and rates. Futures Binance Futures will launch the  USDⓈ-M ZRO Perpetual Contract  at  2024-06-20 14:30 (UTC) ,   with up to 50x leverage.  More details on the USDⓈ-M ZRO Perpetual Contract can be found in the table below:   USDⓈ-M Perpetual Contract ZROUSDT Launch Time  2024-06-20 14:30 (UTC)  Underlying Asset LayerZero (ZRO) Settlement Asset USDT Tick Size 0.001 Capped Funding Rate +2.00% / -2.00% Funding Fee Settlement Frequency Every Four Hours Maximum Leverage 50x Trading Hours 24/7 Multi-Assets Mode Supported Please Note:  The maximum funding rate of the ZROUSDT Perpetual Contract at the time of launch is +2.00% / -2.00%.  The funding fee settlement frequency is  every four hours . Time Max Funding Rate 2024-06-20 16:00 (UTC) +2.00% / -2.00% 2024-06-20 20:00 (UTC) +2.00% / -2.00% 2024-06-21 00:00 (UTC) +2.00% / -2.00% 2024-06-21 04:00 (UTC) +2.00% / -2.00% … … Based on market risk conditions, Binance may adjust the specifications of the ZROUSDT Perpetual Contract from time to time, which include the funding fee, tick size, maximum leverage, initial margin, and/or maintenance margin requirements. Multi-Assets Mode  allows users to trade the ZROUSDT Perpetual Contract across multiple margin assets, subject to the applicable haircuts. For example, when the Multi-Assets Mode is activated, users can use BTC as margin when trading the ZROUSDT Perpetual Contract.  The ZROUSDT Perpetual Contract is subject to the  Binance Terms of Use  and the  Binance Futures Service Agreement .
